newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat firms on export deals.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat firms on export deals.

text.p: Argentine wheat firmed in good-volume cash market trade at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with business bouyed by talk of export deals in the MidEast, traders said.

Spot prices paid to farmers for cash wheat in Bahia Blanca rose $3 to $136. April maize was unchanged at $100 in tight turnover, with buyers stubborn and scarce. May soybeans were steady at $250 in slow trade. April sunflower seed rose $2 to $202 in moderate volume, with sunflower prices still correcting recent falls and some concern over damage to the crop by sclerotinia fungus.
